blurb: Get ready to be transported to an era of charm and industrial chic at Top of the Market. This one of a kind wedding and event venue in Dayton, Ohio. Formerly a historic train depot in the heart of Dayton, Top of the Market has been transformed to meet the unique needs of modern celebrations.
